occurrences.quote: Who was Princess Charlotte of Lorraine and who was her father? Was her father a member of the Lorraine family whose descendants included Umberto II of Italy?
Who was Princess Charlotte of Lorraine, who was her father, and what is the documented genealogical line connecting her father to Umberto II of Italy?
Without identifying who Princess Charlotte of Lorraine is and confirming her father's identity, the chain of reasoning cannot be completed.

Clarification of "Princess Charlotte of Lorraine": The passages contain "Princess Anne Charlotte of Lorraine" but it is unclear if this is the same person referenced in the claim, or if another "Princess Charlotte of Lorraine" exists.

Connection between Leopold, Duke of Lorraine and Umberto II of Italy: If Anne Charlotte of Lorraine (daughter of Leopold) is the intended person, a passage establishing that Leopold, Duke of Lorraine is an ancestor of Umberto II of Italy would be needed. Currently, passage [1] attributes Umberto II's descent to Louis, Count of Armagnac, not to Leopold.
